mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO pets ( owner_id, name, type, breed, gender, birth_date, weight, color, vaccinated, image, note, status, deleted, created_at, updated_at
) VALUES ( #{ownerId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{breed}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{weight}, #{color}, #{vaccinated}, #{image}, #{note}, 'AT_HOME', false, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, o.full_name AS owner_name FROM pets p JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id=o.id WHERE p.deleted=false AND o.deleted=false ORDER BY p.id DESC
SELECT p.*, o.full_name AS owner_name FROM pets p JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id=o.id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.deleted=false
mapper.update: UPDATE pets SET owner_id=#{ownerId}, name=#{name}, type=#{type}, breed=#{breed}, gender=#{gender}, birth_date=#{birthDate}, weight=#{weight}, color=#{color}, vaccinated=#{vaccinated}, image=#{image}, note=#{note}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE pets SET deleted=true, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, o.full_name AS owner_name FROM pets p JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id=o.id WHERE p.type=#{type} AND p.deleted=false
SELECT p.*, o.full_name AS owner_name FROM pets p JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id=o.id WHERE p.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND p.deleted=false
SELECT p.*, o.full_name AS owner_name FROM pets p JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id=o.id JOIN users u ON o.id=u.owner_id WHERE u.id=#{userId} AND p.deleted=false
mapper.update: UPDATE pets SET status=#{status}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
